ink.purpose: Body text and titles on white and pale fills; the same black as the line by day.

line.purpose: Every border, balloon tail, underline and SVG stroke at --stroke.

sky.purpose: Establishing panel, 服務 chapter, send panel, finale, drawn skies.

sky-pale.purpose: Screenshot frames, code strip, skills panel, build service header, drawn header bars.

sand.purpose: Façades, browser title bars, ground strip, chart bars.

sand-pale.purpose: 作品 chapter, comp strip, feature service header, quote panel, close-up, sidewalk tiles.

caption.purpose: Caption boxes, pressed filters, checked ticks, brand balloon, skip link, ::selection, sun, crane cab.

red.purpose: Story objects only: mail/send buttons, 聯絡 tab, 接案中 sign, red postbox.

panel.purpose: Default panel fill and the masthead bar.

balloon.purpose: Balloons, plain buttons, filters, tick boxes, chips, end mark, toast; stays white at night.

green.purpose: The green postbox and API status dots.

steel.purpose: Counterweights, water tanks, sheds, monitor stands, postbox plinths.

window.purpose: Unlit skyline windows (all windows by day).

link.purpose: 開啟網站 links and plain anchors.

dim.purpose: Borders of panels faded by the filter; the only lighter line.

on-sky.purpose: Titles and text on Daylight Blue.

panel-night.purpose: Default panel one step deeper than the night page; masthead bar.

line-night.purpose: The line stays black at night.

sky-pale-night.purpose: Screenshot frames and pale-sky panels at night.

sand-night.purpose: Façades and title bars at night.

green-night.purpose: Green postbox and status dots at night.

window-lit-night.purpose: The fixed scatter of lit windows at night.

caption-night.purpose: Caption boxes, pressed filters, checked ticks at night.

on-page-soft-night.purpose: Footer text and footer links at night.

object-white-night.purpose: White objects inside illustrations at night (clouds, windows, devices, letters).

display.purpose: Opening headline only; container-query sized in the establishing panel; at ≥64rem clamp(2.5rem, 6.4cqi, 4.75rem).

display-finale.purpose: The finale headline 有設計稿了嗎？寄來給我看看。

headline.purpose: Chapter titles 作品, 服務, 關於阿良.

title-panel.purpose: Service titles and 報價怎麼算？; 技能與工具 uses 1.625rem.

brand.purpose: 阿良 wordmark in the masthead.

nav.purpose: Masthead links and the 聯絡 tab.

link.purpose: 開啟網站 links and the toast.

caption.purpose: Narration caption boxes; strip captions 0.875rem between 46rem and 64rem.

lede.purpose: Chapter ledes (36em) and the finale lede (30em). Noto Sans TC.

body.purpose: Base running text and tick items. Noto Sans TC.

body-prose.purpose: 關於阿良 paragraphs at a 38em measure.

summary.purpose: Work summaries at 34em in Graphite Ink.

strokes.name: stroke
strokes.purpose: The one pen: every panel, balloon, caption, button, field border and SVG stroke (non-scaling).

strokes.name: stroke-bold
strokes.purpose: The line drawn heavier: current nav underline, email underline, hovered link underline; equals stroke + the 1.5px selection ring.

strokes.name: icon-stroke
strokes.purpose: Custom 24px icons (stroke-width attribute, non-scaling); does not follow --stroke at ≥64rem.

strokes.name: screen-code
strokes.purpose: Coloured code bars on the drawn monitor only; stands for coloured text, not ink.

strokes.name: dash
strokes.purpose: Data links and the letter's flight path.

shadows.name: heavier-line
shadows.purpose: Not a shadow: the line drawn heavier. Hover on buttons, filters, toggle, 聯絡 tab, tick boxes; resting state of pressed filters and checked ticks.

shadows.name: selected-panel
shadows.purpose: Work panel hover/focus-within and filter matches; --select is the line by day, Lamp Yellow (#f6d670) at night.

motion.name: cut
motion.purpose: Every panel entrance: a hard cut, no easing.

motion.name: opening-sequence
motion.value: establish 0s · crane load 0.1s · portrait 0.3s · balloon 0.65s · strips 1s, stagger 0.28s

motion.name: crane-stop-motion
motion.purpose: The crane lowers the web page in eight frames; the only stop-motion.

motion.name: work-cuts
motion.purpose: Work panels cut in by batch in reading order.

motion.name: toast
motion.purpose: Copy confirmation hard-cuts in and out.

motion.name: transitions
motion.purpose: The stylesheet declares no transitions or keyframes; every state change is instant.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No timelines run, smooth scroll off; content is visible by default with or without JS.

breakpoints.name: xs-max
breakpoints.purpose: ≤: Liang wordmark visually hidden; the 良 balloon mark carries the brand.

breakpoints.name: sm-max
breakpoints.purpose: ≤: Latin name and toggle label hidden, nav padding 0.55rem, mark 2.4rem.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: ≥: strips 3-up, works 2-col with horizontal lead/full panels, order 7fr/5fr, services 2-col, skills label column, about 4fr/8fr. <: strip art fixed 8.5rem.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: ≥: stroke 2.5px / bold 4px, opening 8fr/4fr at clamp(30rem, 100svh − 22.5rem, 35rem), works on 12 columns, services 6fr/3fr/3fr, finale 1.25fr/1fr, portrait balloon breaks the frame.

containers.name: page
containers.purpose: Album page, masthead inner and footer width.

workPanelPattern.at46rem: 2 columns; the first work (lead) and a full work span both, laid horizontally (shot 58%).
workPanelPattern.note: Comic four-tier rotation: wide+std, three std, std+wide, closing full tier.

drawings.skyline: 960×200, xMidYMax slice; hills, rooftop water tanks, antennas, tin sheds, windows

components.css: .ds-service{max-width:360px;margin:0;padding:0 0 0.5rem;background:var(--panel, #ffffff);color:var(--ink, #16171b);border:var(--stroke, 2px) solid var(--line, #16171b);border-radius:3px}.ds-service-title{float:left;width:100%;margin:1.1rem 1.25rem 0.35rem;padding:0;font:900 1.5rem/1.3 var(--font-letter, "Chiron GoRound TC", "Noto Sans TC", "PingFang TC", "Microsoft JhengHei", sans-serif)}.ds-ticks{clear:both;margin:0;padding:0 0.75rem 0.5rem;list-style:none}.ds-tick{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:0.75rem;padding:0.55rem 0.5rem;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font:400 1.0625rem/1.65 var(--font-sans, "Noto Sans TC", "PingFang TC", "Microsoft JhengHei", sans-serif)}.ds-tick input{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;opacity:0;cursor:pointer}.ds-box{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;width:1.5rem;height:1.5rem;margin-top:0.1rem;background:var(--balloon, #ffffff);color:var(--balloon-ink, #16171b);border:var(--stroke, 2px) solid var(--line, #16171b);border-radius:4px}.ds-box svg{width:1.05rem;height:1.05rem;opacity:0}.ds-box svg *{vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}.ds-tick:hover .ds-box{box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px var(--line, #16171b)}.ds-tick input:checked + .ds-box{background:var(--caption, #ffe07a);box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px var(--line, #16171b)}.ds-tick input:checked + .ds-box svg{opacity:1}.ds-tick input:checked ~ .ds-tick-text{font-weight:700}.ds-tick input:focus-visible + .ds-box{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #1b4e91);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
The portfolio is a ligne claire (清線派) comic album. 阿良 is the protagonist, every shipped website is a panel, and the services, the self-introduction and the contact are further panels of the same story. The ground is a white album page. One uniform ink line outlines every panel, speech balloon, caption box, button, field and illustration: 2px on phones and tablets, 2.5px from 64rem. Every SVG stroke is non-scaling, so a drawing placed small or large keeps exactly the same pen. Fills are flat. Daylight blue and sand ochre carry the midtones, hill green and crane steel fill the props, yellow caption boxes narrate, white balloons speak, and red appears only on objects the story needs: the mail and send actions, the 聯絡 tab, the 接案中 sign hanging from the crane, and the red postbox.

Density is comic-page density, not landing-page air. Panels sit in tiers separated by a narrow white gutter, and each `section` is an album page with a larger gap before the next. Lettering does the voice: Chiron GoRound TC, a rounded gothic, letters titles, balloons, captions, buttons and navigation the way a letterer would. Noto Sans TC sets everything that is read rather than heard. State is drawn, not lit. Hover, current and selection draw the same line heavier. A filter fades the panels that don't match and never moves them. Motion is the comic's own grammar: panels hard-cut in reading order, and one stop-motion crane lowers a web page into the opening scene. The night edition is the same album printed at night. The page turns deep blue, panels go one step deeper, the black line stays, the sun becomes a moon, stars come out, skyline windows light up, and balloons stay white.

The opening panel departs from the direction contract on purpose. The contract planned a line drawing of a desk monitor. The build instead draws a tower crane hoisting a browser window over a rooftop skyline of water tanks, antennas and tin-roof add-ons, with the red 接案中 sign hanging from the jib, so that "making the website" reads as construction in progress. The crane is now the system's signature illustration. Two directions were rejected when the world was chosen: the industry default of headline-left/avatar-right above a row of equal work cards, and the previous case-file stationery world, with its prop realism, textures and shadows.
keyCharacteristics: One pen: a single ink line (`--stroke` 2px, 2.5px at ≥64rem; `--stroke-bold` 3.5px / 4px) on every edge and every SVG stroke, always `vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke` with round caps and joins.
Flat colour only. There are no tonal gradients, no drop shadows, no blur and no texture.
A white album page of near-square panels (3px corners) in tiers, separated by a white gutter.
Yellow caption boxes for narration and labels, white rounded balloons with drawn tails for speech, and red only on story objects.
Selection is the same line drawn heavier. Filtering fades panels without reflowing them.
Motion is hard cuts in reading order plus one stop-motion crane. Nothing eases, and everything is visible without motion.
The night edition swaps the palette, not the drawing.

rules.name: The One Pen Rule
rules.body: Every edge in the album is drawn with the line colour at `--stroke`. There are no grey hairlines, no coloured borders and no second pen. The one sanctioned lighter line is Faded Line, on panels a filter has faded.

rules.name: The Red Object Rule
rules.body: Red is a prop in the story, not an accent. It goes only on mail and send actions, the 聯絡 tab, the 接案中 sign and the red postbox. It never goes on headings, links, emphasis, badges or decoration.

rules.name: The White Balloon Rule
rules.body: Balloons, plain buttons, filters, tick boxes, skill chips and the toast keep a white ground and Lettering Ink in both editions. Captions keep yellow. The night edition darkens the page around them, never the balloons themselves.

rules.name: The Night Edition Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is the same album printed at night. It swaps palette tokens and toggles `.sun`, `.moon` and `.star`. It does not redraw or restyle any illustration.

rules.name: The Letterer and Typesetter Rule
rules.body: Chiron GoRound TC letters anything a comic letterer would letter: titles, balloons, captions, controls, navigation and labels. Noto Sans TC sets anything that is read as running text: ledes, summaries, prose, form items and the footer. Never swap them.

rules.name: The Caption Does the Narrating Rule
rules.body: No small label or eyebrow sits above a title. Narration and category names live in a yellow caption box tucked into a panel's top-left corner.

rules.name: The Gutter Rule
rules.body: Panels never touch and never overlap. A white gutter always separates them. Only balloons may cross a frame.

rules.name: The Fixed Page Rule
rules.body: Filtering never reflows, hides or reorders panels, just as a printed comic page cannot re-panel itself. Non-matching panels fade in place.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Nothing lifts off the page. A state change may thicken a line, fill a box yellow or fade a panel, but it never adds a shadow, an offset or a glow.

rules.name: The Heavier Line Rule
rules.body: Hover, current, pressed and selected are all the same line drawn heavier. That means a 1.5px spread ring (totalling `--stroke-bold`), or a `--stroke-bold` underline under the current nav link and the email address.

dos: **Do** draw every new edge with the line colour at `--stroke` (2px, 2.5px at ≥64rem), and give every SVG child `vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke` with round caps and joins.
**Do** show hover, current, pressed and selected states by drawing the line heavier: a `0 0 0 1.5px` spread ring in the line colour, or a `--stroke-bold` underline.
**Do** fill illustrations only through the flat fill classes, so the night edition recolours them without a second drawing.
**Do** keep balloons, plain buttons, filters, tick boxes, skill chips and the toast white with Lettering Ink, and captions yellow, in both editions.
**Do** tuck narration and category labels into a yellow caption box that shares the panel's top-left border, and give every speech balloon a drawn tail aimed at its speaker.
**Do** vary panel sizes by the comic tier rotation (wide + std, three std, std + wide, a closing full tier) instead of equal cards.
**Do** reveal panels with zero-duration cuts in reading order, and keep every panel visible when motion is reduced or scripts don't run.
**Do** reserve Story Red (#c42f1b) for the mail and send actions, the 聯絡 tab, the 接案中 sign and the red postbox.
donts: **Don't** add drop shadows, blur, glow, texture or soft tonal gradients. Gradient syntax appears only as hard-stop line drawing (the sidewalk joints and the toast's speed lines).
**Don't** add CSS transitions, eased entrances or hover lifts. State changes are instant, and the 1px press on buttons is the only displacement.
**Don't** use red for headings, links, emphasis, badges, errors-as-decoration or ornament.
**Don't** introduce a second line colour or grey hairline borders. The only lighter line is Faded Line on panels a filter has faded.
**Don't** reflow, hide or reorder panels when filtering. Fade the non-matching ones in place.
**Don't** put a small label or eyebrow above a title. Narration belongs in a caption box.
**Don't** redraw or restyle an illustration for the night edition. Swap tokens and toggle the sun, moon and stars.
**Don't** set running paragraphs in Chiron GoRound TC or titles and balloons in Noto Sans TC.
**Don't** fall back to the headline-left/avatar-right hero over a row of equal work cards, or to stationery props (folders, stamps, paper textures), both rejected when this world was chosen.
knownLimits: The avatar exists only as a 480px raster (derived from a 599px original, background removed). In the 關於阿良 close-up it is cropped to cover a tall panel and scaled 1.1×, so it is upscaled about 2× on Retina displays and can look soft. This is a known gap in the source asset, not a target. Replace it with a larger source when one exists.
Six of the eight work summaries (all except 鏡好聽 and 鏡文學) are drafts awaiting the owner's confirmation (`draft: true` in the content data). Don't treat their wording as voice reference.
drift: Icons carry stroke-width="2" and stay 2px at ≥64rem while the uniform line goes to 2.5px.
Filter buttons are lettered at 0.9875rem, off the 0.875/0.9375/1rem steps used everywhere else.
Code-bar strokes on the drawn monitor hard-code #7fb8e3, #e7c17d, #f6d670, #e8eef6 (#7fb8e3 is not a palette token).
Small-radius cluster: 3px, 4px, 5px and 6px sit side by side.
Dead code: .caption--corner is never used in markup; Tailwind @theme colour tokens and the dark custom variant have no utility usage; the arrowDown icon is unused.
